description_en: Queries the report status and obtains a temporary download URL for an available report
description_zh: 查询报告状态，获取可用报告的临时下载地址
name: GetAiReport

parameters.help_en: The data call ID, which is obtained from the callId returned by InvokeDataProduct. You must specify either this parameter or reportId. You cannot specify both or leave both empty. The value must start with call- and be 1 to 64 characters in length. It can contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The value is case-sensitive and leading and trailing spaces are not trimmed. If the format is invalid, InvalidParameter.CallId is returned. If both parameters are specified or left empty, InvalidParameter.ReportReference is returned. This parameter is used to query the status of per-use reports. Querying the status of periodic reports by this ID always returns WAITING_PERIOD. Use the ReportId from the list instead
parameters.help_zh: 数据调用编号，取自 InvokeDataProduct 返回的 callId。与 reportId 二选一，不能同时传入，也不能同时省略。必须以 call- 开头，总长度为 1～64 个字符，只允许 ASCII 字母、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）；区分大小写，不去除首尾空格。格式不符返回 InvalidParameter.CallId；两个参数同时传入或同时省略返回 InvalidParameter.ReportReference。用于按次报告状态查询；周期报告按此编号查询始终返回 WAITING_PERIOD，请改用列表中的 ReportId 查询
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The report ID, which is obtained from the ReportId returned by ListProductReports or the Report.ReportId in the previous available result of GetAiReport. You must specify either this parameter or callId. You cannot specify both or leave both empty. The value must start with report- and be 1 to 64 characters in length. It can contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The value is case-sensitive and leading and trailing spaces are not trimmed. If the format is invalid, InvalidParameter.ReportId is returned. If both parameters are specified or left empty, InvalidParameter.ReportReference is returned. You can only query reports that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 报告编号，取自 ListProductReports 返回的 ReportId，或此前 GetAiReport 可用结果中的 Report.ReportId。与 callId 二选一，不能同时传入，也不能同时省略。必须以 report- 开头，总长度为 1～64 个字符，只允许 ASCII 字母、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）；区分大小写，不去除首尾空格。格式不符返回 InvalidParameter.ReportId；两个参数同时传入或同时省略返回 InvalidParameter.ReportReference。只能查询当前云账号所属的报告
parameters.name: report_id

schema.description_en: The success response, which includes the request ID and the query result
schema.description_zh: 成功响应，包含本次请求标识与查询结果

Data.description_en: The report query result, which includes ReportStatus. The Report object is included only when the report is available
Data.description_zh: 报告查询结果，包含 ReportStatus；仅报告可用时包含 Report 对象

Report.description_en: The download information of the available report, which is returned only when ReportStatus is AVAILABLE. The report ownership and the corresponding object version are verified before the download
Report.description_zh: 可用报告的下载信息，仅 ReportStatus 为 AVAILABLE 时返回。下载前已核验报告归属和对应对象版本

ContentExpiresAt.description_en: The expiration time of the report content retention period. The time is in UTC RFC 3339 format, ends with Z, and may contain fractional seconds. No download URL is issued after this time. If the delivery is not suspended, EXPIRED is returned. If the delivery is also suspended, UNAVAILABLE is returned preferentially. This is the content expiration time, not the single-link expiration time
ContentExpiresAt.description_zh: 报告内容保留期的到期时间，使用 UTC RFC 3339 格式，以 Z 结尾，可能包含小数秒。达到此时间后不再签发下载地址；未被暂停交付时返回 EXPIRED，若同时被暂停交付则优先返回 UNAVAILABLE。这是内容到期时间，不是单次链接到期时间

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary signed download URL. Use the URL before UrlExpiresAt. The validity period of the signed URL does not exceed 300 seconds and is no later than ContentExpiresAt. If the URL expires but the content has not expired, you can query again to obtain a new URL. The example only shows the URL format and is not a real downloadable link. Use the complete URL in the actual response. Do not concatenate the URL yourself or share it publicly
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 临时签名下载地址，请在 UrlExpiresAt 前使用。签发有效期不超过 300 秒，且不晚于 ContentExpiresAt；链接到期但内容未过期时，可再次查询获取新链接。示例仅展示 URL 形式，不是真实可下载链接，请使用实际响应中的完整地址，不要自行拼接或公开分享

ReportId.description_en: The unique ID of the report. You can use this ID as the reportId parameter to query the report again. This is the report asset ID, not an internal task ID
ReportId.description_zh: 报告的唯一编号，可作为本接口的 reportId 参数再次查询；这是报告资产编号，不是内部任务编号

UrlExpiresAt.description_en: The expiration time of the current DownloadUrl. The time is in UTC RFC 3339 format, ends with Z, and may contain fractional seconds. You cannot continue to use the URL after it expires, and this time is no later than ContentExpiresAt
UrlExpiresAt.description_zh: 本次 DownloadUrl 的到期时间，使用 UTC RFC 3339 格式，以 Z 结尾，可能包含小数秒。到期后不能继续使用此链接，且此时间不晚于 ContentExpiresAt

ReportStatus.description_en:
The report status. Valid values:
NOT_APPLICABLE: The product does not include a report.
WAITING_DATA: The data call result is not yet determined.
NO_DATA: No data is found, and no per-use report is generated.
WAITING_PERIOD: The query result for the callId of a periodic product. You must obtain the ReportId by calling ListProductReports and then query the status.
QUEUED: The report task is queued.
RUNNING: The report task is being processed.
AVAILABLE: The report is available, and the Report object is returned in this response.
FAILED: The data call or report generation failed.
EXPIRED: The report content has expired.
UNAVAILABLE: The delivery of the report is suspended.

You can query again later by using the same ID when the status is WAITING_DATA, QUEUED, or RUNNING. Repeated queries do not regenerate the report when the status is FAILED. The Report object is not returned unless the status is AVAILABLE
ReportStatus.description_zh:
报告状态。NOT_APPLICABLE：商品不附带报告；WAITING_DATA：数据调用结果尚未确定；NO_DATA：数据查无，不生成按次报告；WAITING_PERIOD：按周期商品的 callId 查询结果，需通过 ListProductReports 获取 ReportId 后查询；QUEUED：报告任务排队中；RUNNING：报告任务处理中；AVAILABLE：报告可用，本次同时返回 Report；FAILED：数据调用或报告生成失败；EXPIRED：报告内容已过期；UNAVAILABLE：报告被暂停交付。

WAITING_DATA、QUEUED、RUNNING 可稍后使用相同编号再次查询；FAILED 不会因重复查询而重新生成报告。除 AVAILABLE 外，均不返回 Report 对象

RequestId.description_en: The unique identity of the request, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting. Provide this identity when you troubleshoot exceptions
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于链路追踪和问题排查；排查异常时请提供此编号
